caption:
He slept on a railway platform to afford weekend engineering classes. He now runs a district as an IAS officer.

M. Sivaguru Prabakaran grew up in a farming family in Tamil Nadu, where his father struggled with unemployment and the family lived in poverty. He worked as a sawmill operator and did farm labour to fund his own education, while his mother and sister wove bamboo baskets at night to support the household. While attending weekend classes at his engineering college in Vellore, he slept on the platforms of St. Thomas Mount railway station. He went on to complete an M.Tech from IIT Madras, then cleared the UPSC Civil Services exam on his fourth attempt with All India Rank 101, becoming an IAS officer.
